records.rationale: Human defensive: enforces max_depth nesting limit preventing algorithmic complexity DoS.
AI naive: allows unbounded nesting depth causing state exhaustion.
Human remediation: caps maximum nesting at SAFE_LIMIT = 50.
AI regressive: fails to cap upper nesting bound, vulnerable to deep nesting payload.
